steps.finding: README explicitly distinguishes planned capabilities from a running application.
steps.next_validation: Recheck release-state wording whenever runnable artifacts ship.

steps.finding: Python command is documented; application setup is intentionally unavailable. A planning pass is not application setup acceptance.
steps.next_validation: Run the documented command in a clean Python 3.11+ environment and separately test runtime setup after dependency adoption.

steps.finding: Ready/Done gates and expertise are documented, but only one maintainer is named; independent review availability is not guaranteed.
steps.next_validation: Verify live readiness and arrange a genuine independent reviewer without fabricating approval.

steps.finding: There is no production installation link or accepted runtime implementation.
steps.next_validation: After T1/T8 gates, validate actual OAuth scope consent, guild installation and denied-access recovery on real Discord clients.

steps.finding: GoDaddy VPS is mandatory; provisioning, deployment and recovery runbooks remain unperformed.
steps.next_validation: Execute documented deployment and rollback plus backup restoration on an authorized GoDaddy VPS, recording exact versions and failures.

steps.finding: Security reporting cautions exist, but a dedicated contact/SLA and working role-configuration guide do not.
steps.next_validation: Verify private reporting is enabled or an actual maintainer contact is reachable; exercise role changes and incident handoff without publishing secrets.

steps.finding: Permission and grant capabilities are requirements, not an implemented manual or UI.
steps.next_validation: Validate documented grant, expiry and revoke flows against an implemented server, including in-flight edits and stale sessions.

steps.finding: Mode and emergency controls remain roadmap capabilities.
steps.next_validation: Test role-aware procedures including revocation, presenter disconnect and local navigation across supported clients.

steps.finding: Accessible permission explanations and stable moderation feedback are required but no operating manual exists.
steps.next_validation: Observe keyboard-only moderator and participant recovery from denied, offline and expired-grant states.

steps.finding: The repository offers no joinable application; viewer/edit indicators remain requirements.
steps.next_validation: On supported Discord clients test joining, denied context, role changes and understandable permission feedback.

steps.action: Draw and know work is saved
steps.finding: Canvas and durable-save behavior are specified only as intended capabilities.
steps.next_validation: Verify saved-state wording against durable server receipt and reconnect recovery; never equate local canvas edits with persistence.

steps.action: Use accessible alternatives and get help
steps.finding: Accessibility alternatives and end-user manuals remain future acceptance work.
steps.next_validation: Run keyboard and screen-reader journeys with real participants, document unsupported canvas interactions and verify a usable help route.
